title: main kaabe ki beti hoon
body:
main kaabe ki beti hoon - na chino meri chadar
roro ke yahi kehti hoon - na chino meri chadar
1. tukdey kardale tum ne afsoos mere qasim ke
pamaal kiya wavaila sab phool bani hashim ke zinda
na palatkar aaya maidan se mera asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
2. jungal mein bulakar tum ne mere bhai ko mara hai
mere akber ko mara hai mere gazi ko mara hai
karbal mein luta hain kunba keh doongi maa se jakar
<<DIVIDER>>
3. hurmat hai badi kabe ki khaliq ki nazar mein dekho
is chadar ki hurmat bhi kaabe jaisi hai samjho
kaaba hojaye be parda chin jaye agar yeh chadar
<<DIVIDER>>
4. kya azmath hai quran ki hogi yeh qabar kuch tumko
quran mere is sar ka karta hai tawaf aye logon
tum sab ka rehbar quran hum hain quran ke rehbar
<<DIVIDER>>
5. himmat yeh kahan thi tum mein ab jis ka dum bharte ho
ek ghazi ke marne par be parda mujhe karte ho
abbas mera jo hota na chinti meri chadar.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. meri nasl fida hojaye par bhai mera bachjaye
meri daulat-e-jaan khojaye par bhai mera bachjaye
pura na huwa yeh armaan main hogayi bekas be par
<<DIVIDER>>
7. misl-e-abbas-e-jari jab girti farsh-e-zameen par
mere hath pasey gardan the nasir tha na koi yawar
sar naize se bhai ka deta tha dilasa rokar
<<DIVIDER>>
8. hum hashmi ke nouhe mein andaaz-e-buka dete hai
karte hain jo sunke matam hum unko dua dete hai
padhta hai raza jab nouha rodeti hai meri madar
